dict.string: The watch records the route of an outdoor walk, run or hike to Health, and with End when I leave on, ends your workout once you leave the place you started it.
Live heart rate checks whether you are walking, to record a walk rather than a call.
Exercise Analyzer reads your heart rate during a workout started on the watch.
Exercise Analyzer saves each workout you end on the watch to Health, with its sets, and an outdoor walk, run or hike with its route.
